# List of acts of the 2nd session of the 4th Parliament of the United Kingdom

This is a complete list of acts of the 2nd session of the 3rd Parliament of the United Kingdom which had regnal year  48 Geo. 3. This session met from 21 January 1808 until 4 July 1808.
